metadata.meta_description: Download the official SeaNeB News press kit. Learn about our hyperlocal journalism model, mission, media partnerships, and verified digital news publishing platform in India.

content.h1: SeaNeB News Press Kit | Media & Partnership Information
content.intro: SeaNeB News is a fast-growing digital and hyperlocal news platform in India focused on delivering verified city-wise, district-level, and national news updates.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To create a trusted digital ecosystem where local journalism thrives, misinformation is reduced, and communities receive verified news that truly impacts their daily lives.

items.title: Hyperlocal Focus
items.desc: We prioritize city and district-level reporting.

items.title: Open Publishing Model
items.desc: Verified contributors can publish directly after approval.

items.title: Editorial Review System
items.desc: Every story undergoes screening before publication.

items.title: Free & Accessible
items.desc: SeaNeB News is free for readers across India.

items.a: SeaNeB News is a digital hyperlocal news platform in India that publishes verified city-wise, district-level, and national news updates.

items.q: Is SeaNeB News open for partnerships?
items.a: Yes. SeaNeB News welcomes media houses, PR agencies, and digital publishers for collaboration and partnerships.
